# Golden license test vectors (§IX justification)

This directory holds the **byte-identical import** of the license-key golden test
vectors owned and generated by the sibling **sukko-license** repo
(`internal/domain/licensekey/testdata/golden/`). It is the
byte-compatibility contract: a fixed ECDSA P-256 keypair, canonical payloads, and
recorded signatures + expected outcomes that both repos verify with their real
validators. `golden_test.go` asserts every vector against the actual validator and
that these files match `checksums.sha256`.

## Why `keypair.pem` (a PRIVATE KEY) is committed — Constitution §IX

`keypair.pem` is a **published, throwaway test key** with **no security value**:

- It signs only the fixed golden vectors; it never signs a real license and is not
  trusted by any deployment.
- The validator embeds a **different** key (`keys/sukko.pub`) — this keypair is used
  only through the explicit-key test seam (`parseAndVerify(key, goldenPub)`), never
  embedded.
- The production signing key is a **non-exportable GCP Cloud KMS key** that exists
  nowhere on disk (see the sukko-license constitution §IX and this feature's
  DK-wave). Committing this test key does not expose any production secret.

The repo's pre-commit secrets scan (`.githooks/pre-commit`) matches `token=`-style
assignments, not `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----` PEM blocks, so it does not flag this
file; there is no global `*.pem` ignore to override. **Do not** replace this with a
real or production key.

## Regeneration

These files are generated in **sukko-license** (the source of truth) via
`GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 go test ./internal/domain/licensekey/...` and copied here
byte-identical. Never hand-edit them here — regenerate there and re-copy, keeping
both repos' `checksums.sha256` in agreement.
